landmarks.name: Berlin
landmarks.hint: The capital, once divided by a wall that fell in 1989

landmarks.name: Hamburg
landmarks.hint: Germany's biggest port, on the Elbe river near the North Sea

landmarks.name: Munich
landmarks.hint: Bavarian capital, home of Oktoberfest and the Alps on its doorstep

landmarks.name: Cologne
landmarks.hint: Rhine city famous for its huge twin-spired Gothic cathedral

landmarks.name: Frankfurt
landmarks.hint: Skyscraper-filled banking hub, home of the European Central Bank

landmarks.name: Stuttgart
landmarks.hint: Car-making city, headquarters of Mercedes-Benz and Porsche

landmarks.name: Dresden
landmarks.hint: Baroque 'Florence on the Elbe', rebuilt after wartime bombing

landmarks.name: Leipzig
landmarks.hint: City of music where Bach worked; its 1989 protests helped end East Germany

landmarks.name: Hanover
landmarks.hint: Northern trade-fair city with famous royal baroque gardens

landmarks.name: Nuremberg
landmarks.hint: Medieval walled city known for its Christmas market and gingerbread
